es: Contar una experiencia inesperada con cronología estable.
Responder dos preguntas sobre causa y orden sin contradecir el relato.

teaching.explanationEs: La primera aclaración identifica el hecho más antiguo.

teaching.en: Use past perfect for the earlier cause.
teaching.es: Usa past perfect para la causa anterior.
teaching.explanationEs: La forma had más participio mantiene el orden.
teaching.audioText: Use past perfect for the earlier cause.

teaching.en: A turning point changes the next action.
teaching.es: Un punto de giro cambia la acción siguiente.
teaching.explanationEs: El cambio debe tener una consecuencia visible.
teaching.audioText: A turning point changes the next action.

teaching.en: Give the story a clear ending.
teaching.es: Da a la historia un final claro.
teaching.explanationEs: El desenlace responde qué ocurrió al final.
teaching.audioText: Give the story a clear ending.

teaching.en: Keep every answer consistent with the story.
teaching.es: Mantén cada respuesta coherente con el relato.
teaching.explanationEs: Las aclaraciones no pueden añadir otra cronología.
teaching.audioText: Keep every answer consistent with the story.

teaching.en: At first, I was carrying food to a community event. I was delayed because I had left my keys in the flat. Suddenly, a neighbour returned home and opened the building door for me. Later, I collected the keys and took a shortcut through the park. Eventually, I reached the event safely and calmly before lunch began. The keys caused my delay, and leaving them upstairs happened before the neighbour arrived.
teaching.es: Al principio llevaba comida a un evento comunitario. El giro fue la ayuda de un vecino y llegué antes del almuerzo.
teaching.explanationEs: Este modelo integrado muestra orden, causa anterior, giro, final y dos aclaraciones.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras y responde causa y orden.

answer.text: At first, I was walking along the coast with my brother. I was worried because I had left our water bottles in the car before we started. Suddenly, a storm reached the beach, but the keeper of a nearby lighthouse opened the door for us. Later, we waited there and called our parents. Eventually, the rain stopped, and we returned safely. I was worried because we had no water. Leaving the bottles happened first.
accepted: At first, I was walking along the coast with my brother. I was worried because I had left our water bottles in the car before we started. Suddenly, a storm reached the beach, but the keeper of a nearby lighthouse opened the door for us. Later, we waited there and called our parents. Eventually, the rain stopped, and we returned safely. I was worried because we had no water. Leaving the bottles happened first.

My brother and I were following a coastal path when dark clouds appeared. Earlier, I had forgotten our water in the car, so I felt worried. Suddenly, heavy rain began, and a lighthouse keeper invited us inside. We contacted our parents while we waited. Eventually, the weather improved and we walked back safely together. The missing water caused my worry, and forgetting it in the car was the first event.

feedback.es: Los relatos explican el antecedente, el giro, el final y las dos aclaraciones solicitadas.

prompt.es: Escribe 70–100 palabras y aclara causa y desenlace.

answer.text: At first, I was carrying my model to a school exhibition. I felt upset because one wooden piece had broken on the bus. Suddenly, I noticed that the technology workshop was open, and a teacher offered me some tools. Later, I repaired the piece and checked the whole model. Eventually, I presented it to the visitors on time. The broken piece had caused the problem. The story ended with a successful presentation.
accepted: At first, I was carrying my model to a school exhibition. I felt upset because one wooden piece had broken on the bus. Suddenly, I noticed that the technology workshop was open, and a teacher offered me some tools. Later, I repaired the piece and checked the whole model. Eventually, I presented it to the visitors on time. The broken piece had caused the problem. The story ended with a successful presentation.

I was taking a model to our school exhibition when I saw some damage. A small part had broken during the bus journey, which caused the problem. Suddenly, a teacher invited me into the open workshop and helped me choose safe tools. Later, I fixed and tested the model. Eventually, the exhibition opened, and I explained my work to the visitors. It ended with the model repaired and ready on time.

feedback.es: Ambas versiones mantienen la causa, el giro, el desenlace y respuestas consistentes.
